ad_groups.name: Mommy & Me Dresses

keywords.activation_gate: Relevant floral products and buyer paths must be cleared.
Relevant floral products and buyer paths must be cleared.

descriptions.text: Shop matching dresses for mom and daughter. Each dress is priced and sold separately.
Explore floral and maxi styles for shared photos and outings. Find your matching look.
Choose a dress style, then select each size. Compare both sizes with the product chart.
Browse mother and daughter dresses. Review checkout delivery estimates before ordering.

ad_groups.hypothesis: Category-specific choice will qualify dress shoppers better than a generic family message or a single-design destination.
ad_groups.risk: Queries may imply infant sizes, formalwear, particular fabrics, or delivery deadlines the reviewed assortment cannot satisfy.

ad_groups.name: Family Matching Outfits

descriptions.text: Shop matching family outfits. Prices apply to each selected item, not the whole family.
Browse coordinated dresses, shirts and sets. Find a shared look for photos and outings.
Choose each person's pieces and sizes. Check which matching options are available.
Plan your coordinated family look. Check delivery estimates before ordering for an event.

ad_groups.hypothesis: Coordinated dress-and-shirt messaging will help shoppers assemble suitable multi-item orders.
ad_groups.risk: The desired father/mother/child combination may not be available in every design. Vacation and photo-event searches can also carry arrival deadlines.

ad_groups.name: Family Matching Shirts

descriptions.text: Shop family matching shirts and tops. Each item is selected and priced separately.
Explore button-up shirts and tees in coordinated prints. Find your next matching look.
Choose adult and child options. Check the size chart and availability for every person.
Find matching tops for family photos and days together. Review delivery at checkout.

ad_groups.hypothesis: Shirt-specific advertising and a shirt-focused destination will reduce selection friction compared with generic outfit advertising.
ad_groups.risk: Some family-shirt searches are for custom slogans, licensed characters, or personalization that may not be offered.

ad_groups.name: Mommy & Me Pajamas

mommy and me short sleeve pajamas
mommy and me long sleeve pajamas
mommy and me long sleeve pajamas

descriptions.text: Shop mommy and me pajamas. Each person's pajama set is selected and priced separately.
Explore short- and long-sleeve pajama styles in coordinated prints for mom and child.
Choose your matching print, then compare the measurements for each adult and child size.
Browse matching sleepwear and review delivery options at checkout before you order.

ad_groups.hypothesis: Matching-print and sleeve-specific messages will attract shoppers suited to the actual selection.
ad_groups.risk: Full-family, Christmas, infant, fabric-specific, or safety-certification searches can imply requirements not established for this launch.

ad_groups.name: Father & Son Shirts

keywords.text: father son matching button up shirts
father son matching button up shirts
daddy and me button up shirts
daddy and me button up shirts

descriptions.text: Shop matching shirts for dad and son. Each shirt is priced and purchased separately.
Explore tropical prints and coordinated button-up shirts for photos and days together.
Choose dad and child sizes separately. Check both measurements before placing your order.
Browse the Daddy & Me shirt collection. Review delivery estimates before a planned trip.

ad_groups.hypothesis: Button-up and tropical-print specificity will qualify buyers better than general “daddy and me” messaging.
ad_groups.risk: Generic father/son shirt queries may seek printed tees rather than button-ups. Monitor the actual queries before expanding further.

ad_groups.name: Mommy & Me Outfits

keywords.text: mommy and me outfits for pictures
mommy and me outfits for pictures

descriptions.text: Shop mommy and me outfits. Prices apply to each chosen item, not the whole matching look.
Browse matching dresses, sets and coordinated styles. Find a look to share together.
Choose the pieces and sizes for each person. Review the product chart before ordering.
Explore mother and daughter looks for shared occasions. Check delivery before your event.

ad_groups.hypothesis: Broader selection-led messaging will capture shoppers who want matching clothing but have not selected dresses, shirts, or pajamas.
ad_groups.risk: This group can attract browsing and inspiration searches. Its phrase keywords should not consume the campaign unchecked.
